single.rationale: Marzetti demonstrates solid fundamentals with steady margin expansion (operating margin improved from 6.6% to 11.5% over three years), strong cash generation (FCF margin 10.7%), and minimal leverage, but faces revenue growth headwinds (2% FY25 growth) and significant customer concentration risk (29% revenue from Chick-fil-A, 19% from Walmart). The Atlanta plant acquisition and ongoing supply chain optimization suggest management is positioning for future growth, though current valuation (29x P/E) appears full given modest near-term growth prospects.
